data.question: Is this actually private?
data.answer: Yes. **Everything runs on your computer**. Voice recordings stored locally. AI model runs locally. Nothing sent to any server. Run with internet disabled - works perfectly. (Optional cloud models coming, but default is always **local-first**)

data.question: Does it work offline?
data.answer: Yes. After one-time AI model download (**2-10 GB**), everything runs on your computer. Laptop in airplane mode? **Still works perfectly**.

data.question: How fast is it?
data.answer: Depends on computer, model choice, and speech length. Decent laptop with small model: 1-3 seconds for few sentences. With GPU acceleration: near-instant. Larger models take few seconds longer but more accurate.

data.question: How accurate is it?
data.answer: Very. The AI models we use (e.g., `Whisper`, `Parakeet`, `Moonshine`) are among **best free speech recognition models** available. Accuracy depends on audio quality, background noise, and model. Larger models more accurate but slower. In practice: **accurate enough for daily use** without constant corrections.

data.question: What languages are supported?
data.answer: All major languages: English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Russian, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, and more. Select language in settings. Different models support different languages. Some have specific language variants.

data.question: Will this work on my computer?
data.answer: **Windows 10/11**: yes. macOS and Linux: coming soon. Don't need powerful computer, but GPU acceleration helps (`NVIDIA CUDA`). Works fine on CPU-only, just bit slower.

data.question: What microphone do I need?
data.answer: Whatever you already have. Built-in laptop mics work. USB mics work. Headset mics work. Better microphones = better results, but don't need anything special.

data.question: Can I customize the keyboard shortcut?
data.answer: Yes. Default is Ctrl+Space, change to whatever you want in settings.

data.question: What about my clipboard?
data.answer: App saves clipboard before pasting, restores after. Your copied content isn't lost.

data.question: Can I use this at work?
data.answer: Yes. **Commercial license included**. Use for personal projects, professional work, client communications, whatever you need.

data.question: What if I have problems?
data.answer: Email creator directly. Personal help. If broken, will fix. If confusing, will explain. You're not alone.

data.question: What's the catch with Early Access?
data.answer: No catch. Product works now. Called Early Access because actively building new features based on user feedback. You help shape what gets built next, and get lowest price ever.

data.question: Will the price increase?
data.answer: Yes. This is **Early Access pricing**. When product leaves beta, price goes up. Buy now to lock in **lifetime access** at this price. **No future charges, ever**.

data.question: What's your refund policy?
data.answer: 30-day money-back guarantee. Don't like it? Email for refund. No argument, no hassle.
